events.title: Win the full game! Top 10 on each demo leaderboard gets a free key 🏆
events.summary: The climb just got serious. The two demo leaderboards are now an official competition: the top 10 players on each board win a free key for the full game at launch — 20 keys in total.🏆 The two leaderboardsMost kills in a single run — pure carnage. Build big, survive long.Fastest Floor 1 clear — pure speed. Summon the boss, beat it, take the portal.📅 DeadlineRankings freeze on October 26 at 23:59 UTC. Whatever the boards show at that moment decides the winners.🎥 Video (optional, but recommended)A

events.title: Meet Bob — the CapyTective 🔎
events.summary: A detective by trade and by nature: sharp nose, sharper instincts. Nothing escapes the CapyTective — not clues, not loot, and definitely not the horde. His Detective's Nose only gets keener as he climbs: the higher the floor, the luckier the finds and the deadlier the hits. Take the CapyTective up the tower yourself — the free demo is out now! More capybara case files coming soon 🕵️

events.title: The Capy of Gods demo is OUT NOW — start climbing!
events.summary: The tower is open! The Capy of Gods demo is now available.
